_readme: Migration data for packages/ui/icons. Each entry: canonical name -> every (file, module, export) that currently imports the old icon and must become `import { name } from "@trymatcha/ui/icons"`. `module` for a custom-icon move is the OLD relative import path, not a react-icons subpackage. Entries under `manual` are excluded from the generic codemod on purpose (see plan Task 9) - do not blindly rename them.

manual._note: Excluded from the generic codemod. See plan Task 9 for exact before/after per item.

sameFileSplit.detail: Two call sites of the same import in one file need two different final names: the plain CTA-button usage becomes NavCtaArrowIcon (already listed under navigation, this file included there for that usage only); the usage rotated -rotate-45 next to the Discord icon becomes ExternalLinkIcon instead.
